usedFor: Qencode transcodes media, and “Start Transcoding Job” begins from a source URL or a stitched file.

bestTemplate.name: “Start Transcoding Job” in Qencode
bestTemplate.why: It starts a video or audio transcoding job, so new media is processed without a manual upload.

watchOut: “Start Transcoding Job” needs a source URL or a stitched file, so have one ready.
